extra_specs.runner_install_template: base64 byte[] script template, not complete cloud-init YAML
extra_specs.extra_context: map[string]string; trusted checksum may be passed here; InstallRunnerParams has no checksum field

common_contract.linux_privilege: runner default user has ALL=(ALL) NOPASSWD:ALL. Hook must explicitly obtain root for root operations or prefix individual privileged operations; standalone root script cannot be dropped in unchanged.
common_contract.linux_wrapper: GetCloudConfig -> GetRunnerInstallScript -> GetCloudInitConfig, base64 write_files + SSH/CA/package config
common_contract.template_boundary: Go text/template; safely emit trusted rendered script as literal, including literal {{, quotes and Unicode. Never allow repo/job Go template injection.
common_contract.macos: provider spec GetTools rejects unsupported OS before rendering hooks; GARM OS validation and AWS host lifecycle also unavailable.
common_contract.package_defaults: NewDefaultCloudInitConfig installs curl/tar only; DisableUpdatesOnBoot clears that list before ExtraPackages are added. Hook dependency packages must be explicit, including python3/sudo/coreutils.

aws.linux: base64(raw cloud-init or Go gzip if >=16384 bytes)
aws.windows: base64(<powershell>script</powershell> or Go zip if >=16384 bytes)
aws.out_rider_gate: Bound complete delivered bytes before Create spawn. A strict conservative uncompressed bound is acceptable if explicit; qualify against actual pinned Go composition, never count only script bytes.

azure.windows: base64 PowerShell script in OSProfile.CustomData, then existing fixed CustomScriptExtension command reads C:/AzureData/CustomData.bin and runs /run.ps1
azure.windows_command_bound: Fixed windowsRunScriptTemplate is UTF16/base64 in commandToExecute; qualify its constant size and include actual CustomData script under same65535 decoded-byte cap. Qualified spec.go42,388-405,480-552.

gcp.bound: Include runner_name/ssh-keys/other selected metadata, escaping and provider wrapper.

required_runtime_evidence: actual pinned Go helpers render supplied hook, not hand-written imitation
rendered hook is script inside one wrapper, not nested full cloud-init
validate resulting shell/cloud-init/PowerShell syntax with installed validators
Linux hook works with common runner user / explicit root transition
quotes, percent, literal template delimiters, Unicode and byte/base64 round-trip
oversized script/CA/SSH/packages rejected before child launch
macOS explicitly rejected before child launch
qualification_limit: Source and local rendering/syntax contract only; no guest, CSE handler or cloud runtime proof.

provider_option_mapping.aws: ComposeUserData replaces all three user_data_options from native extra_specs: extra_packages, disable_updates, enable_boot_debug. Send normalized packages and original flags through those supported extra fields.
provider_option_mapping.azure: Same replacement of packages/disable/debug through native extra_specs; do not rely on bootstrap-only fields.
provider_option_mapping.gcp: ComposeUserData replaces disable_updates/enable_boot_debug from native extras, preserves bootstrap extra_packages. Strict extra schema has no extra_packages: keep packages in normalized bootstrap user_data_options only.
provider_option_mapping.boot_debug: Trusted literal hook never activates common template xtrace; secrets remain redacted.
